cards.name: Orbital Strike
cards.text: 1 adversary troop lands here and stays (it doesn't march) until removed. The adversary gains 2 compute. Sway 1 toward Discord.

effects.why: today's troops op lands on a factory in the country; this lands on the threat's base and stands (never marches or strikes) until removed

cards.value: counter 2 Security tags 10 (or remove 1 of your nodes on or next to it 6, or 7 credits); harm a standing troop 5 (no strike) + 2 compute 4 + sway 4 = 13 shared; 1.3 against the tags, 1.9 against credits
cards.check: Bites from round 1; the troop never strikes, so nothing permanent at tier 1, but it stays on the base (a piece next to sites for placement) until removed; anyone with a node by the base can pay; no loop.
flags: troops needs `at: location` and `stand: true` fields (a standing troop that never marches)
135: the tag option asks 2 Security tags, was 1 (Matt's ruling 1, 2026-11-06: tag-sacrifice counters ask 2 tags at tier 1); value line repriced against 10.

cards.name: Commandeer
cards.text: Each player near it pays 2 energy or discards 2 cards.
cards.value: counter 2 energy (9) or 7 credits; harm the cheaper of 2 energy (9) and 2 cards (8), 8 a player, 12 at 1.5 near; 1.3 against energy, 1.7 against credits
cards.check: Bites all game (a hand of 2+ cards is near-constant); energy seats pay it, others discard; no loop.

cards.name: Supply Raid
cards.text: Each player near it loses 8 credits. The adversary gains 2 compute.
cards.value: counter 2 Security or Industry tags 10 (or 7 credits); harm 8 a player x 1.5 = 12 + 2 compute 4 = 16; 1.6 against the tags, 2.3 against credits
cards.check: Bites rounds 1-5 when 8 credits is a third to half of income; fades late; anyone near a factory pays; no loop.
flags: 135: the tag option asks 2 Industry or Security tags, was 1 (Matt's ruling 1, 2026-11-06: tag-sacrifice counters ask 2 tags at tier 1); value line repriced against 10.

cards.name: Eviction
cards.text: Each player near it pays 8 credits or loses 2 ambassadors.

effects.why: lose_node_or's twin for ambassadors (lose_ambassador's from-supply-else-board rule): tier 1 takes no node

cards.value: counter 6 credits (or remove 1 of your nodes on or next to it, 6); harm the cheaper of 8 credits and 2 ambassadors (8), 8 a player, 12 at 1.5 near; 2.0 against credits (and against a node)
cards.check: Bites all game; a player with ambassadors in supply loses those first, so it never strips a held city unless they choose; no loop.
flags: new op lose_ambassadors_or (each player in scope loses count ambassadors, supply first, or pays amount resource; their choice)

cards.name: Call-Up

cards.value: counter 2 Security tags 10 (or remove 1 of your nodes on or next to it 6, or 7 credits); harm 2 ambassadors placed 10 + sway 4 = 14 shared, plus a sway each production they stay; 1.4 against the tags, 2.0 against credits
cards.check: Bites all game; the ambassadors sway Discord at each production on the base until removed (5 each to remove), so leaving them costs more than the counter; no loop.
flags: ambassadors needs an `at: location` value (the threat's base)
135: the tag option asks 2 Security tags, was 1 (Matt's ruling 1, 2026-11-06: tag-sacrifice counters ask 2 tags at tier 1); value line repriced against 10.

cards.value: counter 2 Security tags 10 (or 6 credits, or 2 ambassadors 8); harm one more tier-1 threat (its counter about 7, uncountered about 12) + 2 compute 4 = 11-16; 1.1-1.6 against the tags, 1.8-2.7 against credits
cards.check: Bites rounds 1-4; the extra card is always tier 1, even into stage II; it is drawn while this card is still out of the deck, so it can't deal itself; a drawn threat that doesn't fit the country is discarded (draw rule); one deal a copy, no loop.
